explanation: Ringel's conjecture for large n (Montgomery–Pokrovskiy–Sudakov): K_{2n+1} decomposes into 2n+1 edge-disjoint copies of any n-edge tree. Copies are images under vertex embeddings, pairwise edge-disjoint with union ⊤. Since 2n+1 copies of n edges cover the n(2n+1) edges exactly, this is an exact decomposition. The statement is correct and solved.
